integration.qualityDenominator: 12 unique questions; mirrored tenants and engines repeat those questions.
integration.memory: Manually supplied fact update becomes visible in retrieved value; deletion disappears and neighbor survives. One item per namespace, not a ranking or embedding-freshness benchmark.

cacheDiagnostic.status: Targeted post-observation query amendment; not a preregistered false-hit-rate study.
cacheDiagnostic.thresholdScale: MongoDB vectorSearchScore = (1 + cosine) / 2; not raw cosine.
